svg.title: Haploid Yeast Cells Mate
svg.desc: Original yeast artwork at its undistorted pixel proportions, with editable labels. The three-slide sequence shows compatible a and alpha haploids, mating, and a diploid a/alpha cell.
svg.metadata: Art: original embedded 563 x 647 bitmap from the lecture figure. Equal x/y pixel scale; each viewport focuses on its current stage. Original cells, factor arrows, and progression arrows retained; live labels repositioned. Drawing references: biological illustration handbook, Clarity; Mastering SVG, viewBox.
